name: agent-swarm
title_zh: 按当前 harness 能开几个子代理就开几个
tagline_zh: 不用换框架、不绑模型：它先探明你手头这套 harness 到底能开哪些子代理，再据此把任务拆成编排者和工人。
tagline_en: No new framework, no model lock-in: it probes which child agents your current harness exposes, then splits work.
desc_en: Coordinate delegated work through the child-agent capabilities available in the current harness. Use when the user asks to spawn agents, delegate, swarm, parallelize, race approaches, or when active instructions require an orchestrator and worker split. Does not require Traycer, a specific provider, or a fixed model.
why_zh: 先探测能力再分工，而不是假设你有某个特定平台。所以同一套编排逻辑在别的 harness 上也能跑。
why_en: It probes capabilities before splitting, instead of assuming a specific platform — so the same orchestration logic survives a.
limit_zh: 它只做编排和分工，子代理本身的能力上限由你的 harness 决定；如果当前环境根本开不出子代理。
limit_en: Orchestration only — child-agent power comes from your harness. If none can be spawned, it falls back to single-threaded work.
title_en: Spawn whatever child agents your harness supports, then.
